name: The Library
source:
I’m Nora. Dani’s my sister, and I care about her more than anything. But Ren, her boyfriend? I need to see if he’s really good for her.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/639380]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
我是諾拉。丹妮是我姊姊，我把她看得比什麼都重。至於她的男朋友倫？我得看看，他到底適不適合她。

［摘自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/639380]Newgrounds[/url]］
